$description: Density, context comfortable: default on desktop and in the console. Dense like Discord, with room for long agent replies.

row-post.$description: Post row in the forum (two lines: title, metadata).

row-suggestion.$description: Row in the suggestion list and the quick switcher.

message-gap.$description: Gap between message groups of different authors.

message-gutter.$description: Indent of the message content from the start of the row: the avatar column (size.avatar-md plus space.12) where it fits; 0 on touch, where a small avatar (size.avatar-sm) leads the header line and the content uses the full width (M5-17).

composer-pad-x.$description: Horizontal padding of the text inside the input, between the buttons in the field (M5-17).

composer-inset-x.$description: Horizontal gap between the input and the edges of the history column (M5-17).
